messages.content: 尋找華盛頓特區的國家博物館和巴黎的羅浮宮博物館的開放時間和成人門票及兒童門票。

function.name: museum_info_get_info
function.description: Retrieve specific details about museums, such as opening hours and ticket prices. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: City where the museum is located.

details.description: List of details to retrieve about the museum.

But maybe they refer to "National Museum of the United States" but there is no single "National Museum". Could be "National Museum of American History" or "National Museum of Natural History". We need to clarify. Also they want info for Louvre in Paris.

The type says details: "Opening hours" | "Adult tickets" | "Child tickets"[]. That might mean details can be one of those strings or an array of "Child tickets"? Actually "Child tickets"[] indicates array of child tickets? Might be a mistake. But we can pass an array of strings: ["Opening hours", "Adult tickets", "Child tickets"].
